data.name: Galumb
data.detailed_description:
🥊 GALUMB

Clench your fists, keep your balance, climb to the top!

Galumb is a chaotic and hilarious party game that turns every match into a fierce brawl with your friends or rivals! The goal is simple: fight your way through obstacle-filled courses and be the first to reach the finish. But you're not alone — everyone around you is dying to knock you down!

🎮 How to Play

Throw punches, unleash kicks, push and shove! In Galumb, you can clear your path by knocking opponents off platforms, or team up temporarily to get through tough sections together. But remember — there's no permanent friendship in this world, and you can get backstabbed at any moment!

🗺️ Dozens of Unique Maps

Battle it out across dozens of maps, each packed with its own traps, obstacles, and surprises. From sliding floors to spinning wheels, from vanishing platforms to explosive traps, every map brings a brand-new challenge.

🧠 Use Your Brain Too!

Reflexes alone won't cut it! Some sections throw math problems and general knowledge questions your way. Get the answer wrong, and watch your path close off — get ready to test both your muscles and your mind.

🏆 No Friends Around? No Worries!

Playing Galumb solo and pushing through to the end is just as competitive and satisfying an experience. Beat your own records, race against the clock, and try to top yourself with every run!

✨ Key Features

  • 🤜 Intuitive push-and-kick physics-based gameplay

  • 🏔️ Dozens of original, obstacle-packed maps

  • 🤝 Form temporary alliances — and break them whenever you like

  • 🧮 Bonus stages themed around math and general knowledge

  • 👥 Multiplayer mayhem with friends or online rivals

  • 🏆 Just as competitive and rewarding when played solo

  • 😂 Guaranteed laughs with physics-based comedy

Whoever reaches the top first wins — how you got there doesn't matter. Push, shove, betray. In Galumb, there's only one rule: stay standing!
